results.instructions:
1. With an electric mixer, beat egg whites, salt and cream of tartar to soft peaks.
  2. Slowly pour in powdered sugar and continue to whip to stiff peaks. Add almond extract, combining until mixture is smooth and glossy.
  3. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper and drop meringue batter in even amounts on the tray. Sprinkle with almonds.
  4. Bake in a preheated oven at 200 degrees until crisp, approx. 1 1/2-2 hours.
  5. Turn off oven and leave meringues in the oven overnight to dry.
  6. Just before serving, toss strawberries with sugar and lemon juice. Set aside.
  7. With an electric mixer, beat Cool Whip with extracts until combined.
  8. Split strawberries and whipped cream amongst six bowls. Crumble meringue cookies over each bowl and stir to mix.

results.instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 375 F.
  2. Prepare a muffin tin. Be sure to spray it thoroughly or these will stick.
  3. Wash apples, and cut in 1/2 and remove core. I used a melon baller.
  4. Thinly slice apples (skin on).
  5. Place apples in bowl with lemon juice and enough water to cover the apples.
  6. Microwave on high until apples can bend without breaking (about 8 minutes).
  7. Drain and pat dry.
  8. Slightly roll out the puff pastry, working with one sheet at a time.
  9. Cut into 6 strips (along the short edge).
  10. Place jam and water in a bowl. Microwave for about 30 seconds just to heat slightly to ease spreading.
  11. Spread some sauce on the strip of puff pastry.
  12. Arrange apple slices on the top half of the slice from end to end.
  13. Fold lower half over apples, and roll.
  14. Place in muffin tin.
  15. Bake for 40 minutes or until golden and done (sauce will bubble into pan).
  16. Let cool for 5 minutes, loosen and remove to finish cooling.
  17. To decorate, sprinkle with sparkling sugar.
